description: Automate a multi-step Python data pipeline build workflow using VSCode tasks.json. The workspace contains a data processing project at /home/ga/workspace/data_pipeline with BUILD_STEPS.txt documenting a 4-step manual workflow. Your goal: Create .vscode/tasks.json in the workspace root that automates this workflow. The tasks.json must: (1) Create a task with label containing 'Build' or 'Package' or 'Workflow', (2) Include all 4 commands from BUILD_STEPS.txt: 'rm -rf dist/', 'python validate_data.py --strict --input data/input.csv', 'python process_data.py --input data/input.csv --output dist/', and 'tar -czf deploy.tar.gz dist/', (3) Use either a shell task with && to chain commands OR a compound task with dependsOn, (4) Set as default build task using 'group': {'kind': 'build', 'isDefault': true}. Read BUILD_STEPS.txt for the exact workflow, then create the tasks.json file that chains all steps together.
